description: This file defines the CameraHandler class used for managing camera operations within an Android application. It includes functions for listing devices, taking snapshots, recording clips, and associated helper methods for logging and parameter parsing.

classes.name: CameraHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for handling camera operations such as listing devices, taking snapshots, and recording clips, with integrated logging and error handling.

methods.name: isCameraClipWithinPayloadLimit
methods.description: Checks if the size of the camera clip in bytes is within the allowed maximum payload size.

methods.name: handleList
methods.description: Lists available camera devices and returns the result as a JSON payload.

methods.name: handleSnap
methods.description: Handles the process of taking a photo using the camera, including logging, HUD updates, and error handling.

methods.name: handleClip
methods.description: Records a camera clip, encodes it in base64, and performs size validation with logging and error handling.

methods.name: parseIncludeAudio
methods.description: Parses the includeAudio flag from the JSON parameters.
